```python
db.execute("""
WITH seg_year AS (
  SELECT
    c.Segment,
    CAST(substr(y.Date,1,4) AS INTEGER) AS yr,
    SUM(y.Consumption) AS consumption
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c
    ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
    AND substr(y.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment, CAST(substr(y.Date,1,4) AS INTEGER)
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2013 THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2012 THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012
  FROM seg_year
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  Segment,
  cons_2012,
  cons_2013,
  (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2013 AS pct_increase
FROM pivot
ORDER BY Segment;
""")

WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT
    t.CustomerID,
    c.Currency,
    SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_spending,
    SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item
  FROM transactions_1k AS t
  INNER JOIN customers AS c
    ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
)
SELECT
  CustomerID,
  avg_price_per_item,
  Currency
FROM customer_totals
ORDER BY total_spending DESC
LIMIT 1;
